title: Sequence diagrams as explanations
summary: A sequence holds to its source (M1: PR 386, PR 397, PR 398), measures what it draws (M2), says what each message is with message= kinds, answers= and action lines (M3), and explains itself with a key, a fixed order line, pair focus and an SVG description (M4). Activation bars (layout root sequence activations=on), insert and move in the editor, and typed Mermaid import were added in the same PR. M2 to M4 and the retirement are in PR 560. Reconciled against dac2b76e: tests/sequence.test.ts, tests/sequence-meaning.test.ts, tests/import-mermaid.test.ts and pnpm prove:sequence pass. The plan came from a Pro research run (PR 331, closed as superseded); its files are at dac2b76e under docs/intent/sequence-explanations.
reason: Byron asked on 2026-11-14 to retire the plan in the PR that ships its last milestone. Every committed milestone is shipped.
follow_ups: Decisions that differ from the plan: answers= replaces reply-to= (no dash in new words) and alone makes a reply; an action is an edge from a participant to itself, not a separate record; activation bars were deferred by the plan and added by Byron behind a switch.
Not built, no scope statement: a footnote states the scope, and a second way to say it adds nothing.
Not built, fragments (alt, opt, loop, par): Byron decided that they stay out. A phase is a narrative band; the Mermaid import turns each top-level branch into a phase and warns.
Not built, the plan's Explore list: phase collapse, navigation on a phone, one local alternative, parallel operands, order suggestions. None had a build commitment.
Not built, deferred by the plan: the full UML notation and measured time.
Not run: the reader study (SEQ-16). Tests cover geometry and meaning, not comprehension.
Not built: a draftably command for layout settings such as activations=on; set edits declarations only.
Not built: a before and after view of a change of kind; compare refuses such files.
Not changed: named emphasis states keep their rule (they list what is in focus). Pair focus is for a selection in the editor.
Activation import limits: a Mermaid bar from a bare activate line stays off with a warning, and a dotted line with a cross, no arrowhead or two arrowheads becomes a reply with a plain arrowhead.
Editor limits: insert and move work on a file only, and the Inspector still shows port fields for a message.

title: Diagram DSL and shared file editing
summary: All four milestones shipped in PR 4 to PR 7 (on top of PR 3), merged on 2026-10-15: the .meld language, compiler and headless CLI (check, format, inspect), a watched file in the editor with revision-checked atomic saves, viewer edits written as source (a drag writes near, then pin, size, declarations), and stay anchors, layout notes, Reflow group and pnpm prove:file. The language became .draft in PR 10. Changed from the plan: the root scope does not clamp to nonnegative coordinates, new objects default to color=auto, and a resize writes no move preference. The layout tools that the plan disabled in file mode came back in the layout-in-files work. Reconciled against origin/main 1ae73851 with no local code changes. The planning files are at 1ae73851.
reason: Byron asked on 2026-11-14 to retire plans that shipped. All four milestones are on origin/main, and the map's next action (merge PR 3 to PR 7) is done.
follow_ups: Not built, still refused as UnsupportedEdit: custom connection bends, label positions, images and icons in files.
Below the cut line, not planned: views, static summaries and checkpoints (DSL.md says views and checkpoints are not supported), inset and multi-instance diagrams, multi-user merge.
